eval-bot: Nightly eval finished for rwd/llama3-70b-int8-calib. Regression detected vs baseline: EM -6.3%, BLEU -4.1, hallucination_rate +12%. Affected prompt sets: summarization-breakers, qa-med. Run id: nightly-2025-11-20-07:20. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood/evals/nightly/1766123456 :eyes:
marta: Ugh. Any obvious config change this run compared to last good one?
samir: We switched quant profile to `int8-optimal-v2` (commit abcdef1234) and updated per-layer calibration to use the new per-channel estimator. Also bump calibration samples from 512->1024.
jonah: Quick paste of the eval command we used:
```
./tools/run_eval --model rwd/llama3-70b:2025-11-18-int8 --quant-profile int8-optimal-v2 --calib-samples 1024 --calib-seed 42 --prompts summarization-breakers,qa-med --run-id nightly-2025-11-20
```
samir: I dumped the calibration stats — layernorm/ln1 mean shift is non-trivial vs baseline. Snip of the calib summary:
```
layer: ln1 mean_before: -0.03 mean_after: +0.12 std_before: 0.11 std_after: 0.14
kv_scale layer_13: baseline 0.97 current 1.24
```
jonah: That KV scale jump would explain the hallucination uptick (context mixing). I can repro on my laptop with a smaller prompt set. Sample failing prompt and model output below:
marta: prompt: "Summarize: The report shows the merger completed on April 2, 2024..."
samir: model output (truncated): "The merger closed on March 30, 2023 and resulted in..." -> wrong date and invented detail.
lee: Noted. Two quick experiments to triage: (1) rerun same eval with `int8-stable-v1` profile (previous baseline), (2) run with FP8-preview profile to see if precision reduces the error. I'll queue both tonight.
marta: Also can someone run a quick per-layer ablation: disable per-channel scaling and use global scaling to see whether the bias is from per-channel estimator. Command:
```
./tools/run_eval --model rwd/llama3-70b:2025-11-18-int8 --quant-profile int8-optimal-v2 --calib-mode global --calib-samples 512 --prompts summarization-breakers
```
samir: I'll start a bisect of commits touching `quant/*` between `abcdef1234` and `a1b2c3d4` tomorrow morning. If we find the exact change, we can revert the quant-profile tweak.
jonah: For tracking, created issue RW-ml#4821 with links to diffs and samples.
marta: Thanks. Priority: P1 for nightly regressions because this affects Dedicated customers. Lets keep thread for updates. :thumbsup:
lee: queued FP8 and int8-stable runs. Will post results + links when done. :hourglass:
